comment: Replaces the routing that lived in netlify.toml before the move to Vercel.
Without it /finanzas is a 404: the build emits dist/ecosistema/index.html,
and nothing maps the pretty URL onto that file.
Order is load-bearing — the first matching rewrite wins, so the catch-all
MUST stay last or it swallows the app routes. Each app needs BOTH a bare
and a wildcard rule: '/finanzas/:path*' does not match a plain '/finanzas'.
Static files that actually exist (assets, images, robots.txt) are served
before rewrites are considered, so they need no rules here.
